label: Cardinal ingresses define the annual mundane framework

source.title: Mundane Astrology: The Astrology of Nations and States
source.claim: The Aries ingress is the principal annual chart, but all four cardinal ingresses may be judged as the framework for the mundane year.

label: New Moons define short mundane windows inside the yearly framework

source.title: Mundane Astrology: The Astrology of Nations and States
source.claim: The New Moon chart is important for immediate mundane judgment and usually operates until the next New Moon unless an eclipse supersedes it.

label: Visible and angular eclipses carry stronger mundane testimony

source.title: Mundane Astrology: The Astrology of Nations and States
source.claim: Eclipses are most effective when total or near total, visible for the place concerned, and especially when angular in the relevant chart.

label: Later activations of eclipse degrees can release violent or political events

source.title: Horary Astrology and the Judgment of Events
source.raw_file: horary_knowledge/Horary Astrology and the Judgment of Events (Barbara H. Watters) (Z-Library).txt
source.claim: Movement to eclipse points and angles, especially by Mars or the heavier planets, can precipitate war, riots, assassination, and public crisis.

label: War charts track aggressor and defender through the first and seventh houses

source.title: Horary Astrology and the Judgment of Events
source.raw_file: horary_knowledge/Horary Astrology and the Judgment of Events (Barbara H. Watters) (Z-Library).txt
source.claim: The war chart begins with the first hostilities. The first house signifies the aggressor and the seventh house the defending side.

label: Retrograde Mars corrupts martial policy and can foreshadow failed aggression

source.title: Horary Astrology and the Judgment of Events
source.raw_file: horary_knowledge/Horary Astrology and the Judgment of Events (Barbara H. Watters) (Z-Library).txt
source.claim: Retrograde Mars is linked with broken treaties, unstable rulers, and aggressive action that ends in defeat or self-undoing.

label: Retrograde Mars can destabilize pacts and allied commitments

source.title: Horary Astrology and the Judgment of Events
source.raw_file: horary_knowledge/Horary Astrology and the Judgment of Events (Barbara H. Watters) (Z-Library).txt
source.claim: Retrograde Mars is linked with broken treaties, unstable rulers, and aggressive action that ends in defeat or self-undoing.

label: Great mutations form longer collective backdrops for nations and eras

source.title: Horary Astrology and the Judgment of Events
source.raw_file: horary_knowledge/Horary Astrology and the Judgment of Events (Barbara H. Watters) (Z-Library).txt
source.claim: Jupiter-Saturn conjunctions and larger mutation cycles create master charts that describe broad eras, including economic and social turning periods.

label: Revolutions may be divided into shorter operative segments

source.title: Bonatti on Mundane Astrology
source.claim: A revolution may signify the whole year or be judged by halves and quarters depending on the structure of the testimony.

label: Place, climate, and region modify the scope of a mundane indication

source.title: Bonatti on Mundane Astrology
source.claim: Geography, climate, and the character of a place change how far and where a mundane indication extends.

label: Treaties and alliances belong to foreign-relations house logic

source.title: Mundane Astrology: The Astrology of Nations and States
source.claim: The seventh house governs relations with foreign countries, open war and enmity, and also treaties and alliances, while the eleventh and ninth modify friendly nations and wider foreign relations.

label: Friendly nations and allied support belong partly to the eleventh house

source.title: Mundane Astrology: The Astrology of Nations and States
source.claim: Friendly nations must be considered under the eleventh house, and all foreign relations must have some relation with the ninth.

label: Alliance stress belongs to the eleventh-house logic of friendly nations

source.title: Mundane Astrology: The Astrology of Nations and States
source.claim: Friendly nations must be considered under the eleventh house, and all foreign relations must have some relation with the ninth.

label: Afflicted Mercury in the seventh can show diplomatic blunders and broken treaties

source.title: The Annotated Raphael's Mundane Astrology
source.claim: Raphael delineates an afflicted Mercury in the seventh as double-dealing with other powers, diplomatic blunders, breaking of treaties, commercial and trade disputes with foreign countries, and general disagreement in international affairs.

label: Trade and commerce belong first to second-house national resources

source.title: Mundane Astrology: The Astrology of Nations and States
source.claim: Green gives the second house national wealth, the Exchequer, taxation, revenue, banks, the stock exchange, commerce, and trade; planets there describe revenue, banking, and stock-market outcomes for the period ruled by the figure.

label: Afflicted Mercury in the seventh can show foreign trade disputes

source.title: The Annotated Raphael's Mundane Astrology
source.claim: Raphael delineates an afflicted Mercury in the seventh as double-dealing with other powers, diplomatic blunders, breaking of treaties, commercial and trade disputes with foreign countries, and general disagreement in international affairs.

label: Public health is a legitimate mundane domain through the sixth house

source.title: Mundane Astrology: The Astrology of Nations and States
source.claim: The sixth house rules public health or sickness, the national services, and workers and employees generally.

label: Hospitals and institutional burden belong to twelfth-house public-health logic

source.title: The Annotated Raphael's Mundane Astrology
source.claim: The twelfth house signifies hospitals and asylums, and in the 1918 influenza appendix Saturn opposing Uranus linked the sixth house of illness with the twelfth house of hospitalization.

label: Retrograde Venus can coincide with epidemic onset in mundane work

source.title: Horary Astrology and the Judgment of Events
source.raw_file: horary_knowledge/Horary Astrology and the Judgment of Events (Barbara H. Watters) (Z-Library).txt
source.claim: Watters says serious epidemics, like the influenza and typhus outbreaks of 1918, often begin when Venus is retrograde.

label: Civil unrest belongs to the people-government-parliament axis, not to generic war logic

source.title: Mundane Astrology: The Astrology of Nations and States
source.pages: First, Fourth, Tenth, and Eleventh house chapters
source.claim: Green assigns the country and its inhabitants to the first house, the people and Opposition in Parliament to the fourth, the Government to the tenth, and Parliament to the eleventh; afflicted Moon, Mars, Saturn, or Uranus testimony across these houses produces discontent, unrest, party splits, and hindered government.

label: Eleventh-house affliction can show parliamentary rupture, adverse votes, and unruly debate

source.title: The Annotated Raphael's Mundane Astrology
source.claim: Raphael assigns Parliament and the House of Commons to the eleventh house; Mars there brings quarrels and party splits, Saturn there shows adverse-vote risk and resignation of the Ministry, Uranus there brings extraordinary difficulties and unruliness, and Neptune there shows socialistic agitation and underhand work among members.

label: Finance belongs first to the second house of treasury, exchequer, banks, and trade

source.title: Mundane Astrology: The Astrology of Nations and States
source.claim: Green gives the second house national wealth, the Exchequer, taxation, revenue, banks, the stock exchange, commerce, and trade; planets there describe revenue, banking, and stock-market outcomes for the period ruled by the figure.

label: Eleventh-house affliction can turn finance into parliamentary blockage and adverse votes

source.title: The Annotated Raphael's Mundane Astrology
source.claim: Raphael says Mercury in the eleventh affects legislation touching trade and commerce, Jupiter there improves trade, finance, and commerce, but if afflicted it brings financial disputes, depreciation of Government securities, and danger of an adverse vote; Saturn there brings ministerial obstacles and danger of an adverse vote in the Commons.

label: Afflicted Venus can show bad alliances and peace commitments that do not hold

source.title: Horary Astrology and the Judgment of Events
source.raw_file: horary_knowledge/Horary Astrology and the Judgment of Events (Barbara H. Watters) (Z-Library).txt
source.claim: Watters says that Libra and Venus signify peace, treaties, and allies, but when Venus is badly afflicted the chart can indicate bad alliances, unfair judges, theft, or plague conditions.

label: The eighth house can show the resources and losses of allies

source.title: Horary Astrology and the Judgment of Events
source.raw_file: horary_knowledge/Horary Astrology and the Judgment of Events (Barbara H. Watters) (Z-Library).txt
source.claim: Watters assigns to the eighth house the resources of allies and dangers or losses through war, epidemics, or taxation, making allied-resource strain a valid mundane consideration.

label: Mercury in the second can bring gains or losses in trade and commerce depending on condition

source.title: The Annotated Raphael's Mundane Astrology
source.claim: Raphael says Mercury in the second gives activity in trade and commerce and, when well aspected, gains through trade, banking, or commerce, but when afflicted brings losses through fraud, theft, sharp practice, and deception.

label: Mercury in the ninth can shift international trade and commercial disputes

source.title: The Annotated Raphael's Mundane Astrology
source.claim: Raphael says Mercury in the ninth gives activity in the law courts, commerce, foreign affairs, and shipping, but if afflicted it may bring disputes over trade and commerce.

label: A second epidemic peak can follow months after the first under the same wave family

source.title: The Annotated Raphael's Mundane Astrology
source.claim: Raphael's influenza appendix says the highest mortality occurred after the October 1, 1918 Saturn-Uranus opposition and that a second but less severe peak in the death rate occurred in the UK in February 1919 after the January 25, 1919 Saturn retrograde opposition.

label: The October 1918 New Moon can define a peak epidemic wave window

source.title: The Annotated Raphael's Mundane Astrology
source.claim: Raphael says the period of highest mortality occurred during the lunar month that began with the New Moon of 4 October 1918 and ended with the New Moon of 3 November 1918.

label: An eclipse can mark subsiding epidemic pressure as well as intensification

source.title: The Annotated Raphael's Mundane Astrology
source.claim: Raphael says the solar annular eclipse of 3 December 1918 occurred and that the epidemic subsided substantially after this date.

label: Bad Sun-Uranus configurations can signal government defeat and party fracture

source.title: Mundane Astrology: The Astrology of Nations and States
source.claim: A bad aspect of the Sun to Uranus can bring sudden trouble on the government, party splits, failed bills, government defeat, election upheaval, and riot risk.

label: Royal eclipse hits belong to leadership-transition doctrine rather than generic government strain

source.title: Mundane Astrology: The Astrology of Nations and States
source.claim: Green repeatedly treats visible eclipses on royal luminaries, ascendants, or midheavens as testimony for monarch death or coronation crisis, which is leadership transition rather than generalized regime instability.

label: Parliamentary blockage belongs to regime-stability doctrine rather than leadership-transition logic

source.title: The Annotated Raphael's Mundane Astrology
source.claim: Raphael ties the eleventh house to Parliament and adverse votes, and links the 1909-1911 House of Lords crisis to a conjunction period that brought serious parliamentary difficulties, which is institutional regime stress rather than a single office-holder transition.

label: Bad Sun-Neptune configurations can signal government defeat and collapse

source.title: Mundane Astrology: The Astrology of Nations and States
source.claim: Green says a bad aspect of the Sun to Neptune can bring failure of measures, government defeat, danger to a prominent statesman, and something in the nature of a downfall or collapse.

label: Uranus through a country's sign can show reform agitation, strikes, and rioting

source.title: The Annotated Raphael's Mundane Astrology
source.claim: Raphael says Uranus passing through the sign ruling a country can cause insurrections, strikes, rioting, and anarchist or nihilistic outrages, and cites events then occurring in India while Uranus passed through Capricorn, the sign ruling India.

label: The sixth house can carry workers, unions, and strike unrest

source.title: The Annotated Raphael's Mundane Astrology
source.claim: Raphael assigns to the sixth house the nation's workers and servants, trade unions, strikes, wages, unemployment, and service classes, making labor unrest a valid sixth-house mundane output rather than only a first-fourth-tenth-eleventh axis reading.

label: Event charts should still be checked against national charts when available

source.title: Horary Astrology and the Judgment of Events
source.raw_file: horary_knowledge/Horary Astrology and the Judgment of Events (Barbara H. Watters) (Z-Library).txt
source.claim: Even with an exact war-event chart, the national horoscope should not be ignored; comparing the event chart with the national chart helps confirm that the event is definitive and serious.

label: War outbreak doctrine starts from first hostilities and 1st versus 7th polarity

source.title: Horary Astrology and the Judgment of Events
source.raw_file: horary_knowledge/Horary Astrology and the Judgment of Events (Barbara H. Watters) (Z-Library).txt
source.claim: Watters says the war chart begins with the first hostilities, the first house signifies the aggressor, and the seventh house the defending side.

label: Going-to-war charts can show sixth-house armed-forces emphasis

source.title: The Annotated Raphael's Mundane Astrology
source.claim: Louis says Operation Desert Storm began shortly after the January 15, 1991 solar eclipse and notes that sixth-house emphasis commonly occurs in charts of going to war.

label: Saturn can show campaign attrition after an initially strong opening

source.title: Horary Astrology and the Judgment of Events
source.raw_file: horary_knowledge/Horary Astrology and the Judgment of Events (Barbara H. Watters) (Z-Library).txt
source.claim: Watters says that after a glorious beginning the attrition of Saturn would take over, the Northern blockade would tighten, and Grant's strategy would turn the Civil War into a textbook case of widening campaign pressure.

label: An eclipse can move from war entry into a sustained campaign window

source.title: The Annotated Raphael's Mundane Astrology
source.claim: Louis says Operation Desert Storm began after the January 15, 1991 eclipse and lasted 38 days, showing that eclipse testimony can remain active across a sustained military campaign rather than only at the opening strike.

label: Retrograde Mars can foreshadow failed aggression and defender victory

source.title: Horary Astrology and the Judgment of Events
source.raw_file: horary_knowledge/Horary Astrology and the Judgment of Events (Barbara H. Watters) (Z-Library).txt
source.claim: Watters says that when judging the outbreak of war it is the aggressor nation which suffers from retrograde Mars and that however remote victory may seem for the defenders, it will be theirs.

label: Battle reversals can be signaled by eclipse-driven balance shifts

source.title: The Annotated Raphael's Mundane Astrology
source.claim: Louis says the lunar eclipse before Gaugamela tipped the balance in favor of Alexander, that the Persian army became demoralized, and that invisible Jupiter with prominent Saturn was ominous for Darius before his defeat.

label: Afflicted Moon in the eleventh can show loss of friends abroad

source.title: Mundane Astrology: The Astrology of Nations and States
source.claim: Green says that if the Moon is afflicted in the eleventh the nation is liable to lose friends abroad, tying ally-network failure directly to the eleventh house.

label: Benefic treaty and commerce indicators can support trade liberalization

source.title: Mundane Astrology: The Astrology of Nations and States
source.claim: Green says the Sun in the ninth favors shipping and foreign trade, good Sun-Jupiter aspects improve trade and commerce, and favorable Moon-Mercury combinations are good for signing commercial treaties and legislation.

label: Mars in the sixth can intensify epidemic-wave pressure

source.title: The Annotated Raphael's Mundane Astrology
source.claim: Raphael ties Mars to infectious diseases and says the sixth house is the house of joy of Mars, making Mars-in-sixth configurations valid for epidemic-wave pressure rather than only generic illness.

label: Neptune in the twelfth can cloud hospital and institutional wave conditions

source.title: The Annotated Raphael's Mundane Astrology
source.claim: Raphael links Neptune with strange and widespread illnesses and the twelfth house with hospitals and institutional burden; in the influenza appendix Neptune was prominent as the epidemic picture developed.
